title: ProductPerformanceEfficiency
description: TOGAF-sourced quality archetype — Performance viability dimension. Defines the property vocabulary for performance governance: latency percentiles, throughput, error rates. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms and as data type for Effectors/Receptors carrying performance state. Source framework: TOGAF (Non-Functional Requirements) + ISO/IEC 25010 (Performance Efficiency sub-characteristic).

p50LatencyMs.description: Median (50th percentile) response latency in milliseconds.

p99LatencyMs.description: 99th percentile response latency in milliseconds. Norm example: Performance.p99LatencyMs < 500.

throughputRps.description: Sustained throughput capacity in requests per second.

errorRatePercent.description: Error rate budget as a percentage (e.g., 0.1 for 99.9% success rate SLO).
